items.problem: The migrated package could not register because runFullTrust followed a custom capability, yet validation returned PASS.
items.evidence: migration-score.json migration_launch_status and session-log.txt lines 3508-3557: 0xC00CE014/0x80080204 identified an unexpected rescap:Capability under Capabilities.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, Test-AppLaunch.ps1, and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 for CustomCapability, capability order, 0xC00CE014, and 0x80080204.
items.wrong_text_if_any: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md said to keep UWP capabilities and add runFullTrust 'no matter what'; Test-AppLaunch.ps1 said never registered always means deployment/environment and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 mapped unavailable to WARN.
items.root_cause: The skill omitted AppX's ordered Capabilities content model and incorrectly treated explicit manifest schema rejection as environmental.
items.proposed_fix: Document the order, add a deterministic validator order check, and classify explicit manifest schema rejection as invalid-manifest/FAIL.
items.generalizes: Any packaged migration combining runFullTrust with custom or device capabilities can build successfully but fail package registration.

items.problem: The prescribed build command was unavailable.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2599-2665: winapp build exited 1 because build is not a winapp command.
items.skill_search: Searched the migration skill for 'winapp build'; it appeared in Step 3, command discipline, final validation, and supporting prose.
items.root_cause: The skill conflated winapp's package-identity launch role with native project compilation.
items.proposed_fix: Use dotnet build against the target csproj and reserve winapp/Test-AppLaunch for launch.
items.generalizes: Every migrated .NET WinUI project needs a reliable build command independent of winapp CLI command availability.

items.problem: Bootstrap copied legacy assembly metadata that conflicts with SDK-generated attributes.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3322-3369: copied BackgroundTask\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs caused six CS0579 duplicate attribute errors.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md for AssemblyInfo and CS0579; no handling existed.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap copied every .cs file, including legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs files that SDK-style projects regenerate.
items.proposed_fix: Exclude legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs during bootstrap copy.
items.generalizes: Classic UWP projects and child projects commonly carry AssemblyInfo.cs and produce the same SDK-style duplicate attribute errors.
